channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Jarmalka Steinmeier oo toddobaadka soo socda booqanaya Kenya
item.description: Madaxweynaha Jarmalka Frank-Walter Steinmeier ayaa la filayaa inuu 24 ilaa 26 November booqasho rasmi ah ku tago Kenya, halkaas oo uu wada-hadallo kula yeelan doono Madaxweyne William Ruto.

item.title: Verstappen oo ka bilaabanaya kaalinta koowaad Las Vegas kaddib ciqaabta Antonelli
item.description: Kimi Antonelli oo u ciyaara Mercedes ayaa ugu dheereeyay u-qalmidda Grand Prix-ga Las Vegas, laakiin ciqaab 5 kaalmood ah ayaa kaalinta koowaad ee bilowga u dhiibtay Max Verstappen oo ka tirsan Red Bull.

item.title: James Harden oo 51 dhibcood dhaliyay, Cavaliers-na ka adkaatay Pacers
item.description: James Harden ayaa 51 dhibcood u dhaliyay Cleveland Cavaliers oo Jimcihii 128-119 kaga adkaatay Indiana Pacers koobka NBA Cup, wuxuuna kaalinta 3aad uga gudbay taariikhda NBA ciyaaraha uu ciyaaryahan 50 dhibcood ama ka badan dhaliyo.

item.title: Jair Bolsonaro oo isbitaal la dhigay kaddib xanuun caloosha ah
item.description: Madaxweynihii hore ee Brazil Jair Bolsonaro, oo xabsi guri ugu jira xukun 27 sano ah, ayaa Jimcihii la dhigay isbitaal ku yaal Brasília kaddib xanuun caloosha ah, sida uu sheegay wiilkiisa Carlos.

item.title: Trump oo ku baaqay in Jensen Huang dib loogu celiyo hoggaanka shirkadda Nvidia
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa in Jensen Huang, oo iska casilay xilka madaxa fulinta ee shirkadda Nvidia, la siiyo fursad labaad, isagoo ku booriyay inuu bixiyo raalli-gelin weyn.

item.title: EuroLeague: Barcelona oo 100-103 guriga kaga lumisay Crvena Zvezda, garsoorayaashana dhaleeceysay
item.description: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee FC Barcelona ayaa Jimcihii 100-103 kaga lumisay Crvena Zvezda kulan waqti dheeraad ah gaaray oo ka dhacay Palau Blaugrana, kaddibna tababaraha Aleksander Sekulic iyo ciyaaryahan Joel Parra ayaa ka cabsaday garsoorka.

item.title: ISBEDDEL LAGU SAMEYNAYO GOLAHA WASIIRRADA XUKUUMADDA SOOMAALIYA
item.description: Warar soo baxaya ayaa sheegaya in isbeddel lagu sameynayo Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi la filayo in lagu beddelo Sadaq Cumar (Sadaq Joon), isla markaana loo magacaabo La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka. Weli war rasmi ah kama soo bixin Villa Soomaaliya.

item.title: Rummenigge oo sheegay in Bayern ay Musiala kala hadli karto dhimista mushaarka haddii caafimaadkiisu soo kabsan waayo
item.description: Xubinta golaha kormeerka Bayern Munich Karl-Heinz Rummenigge ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Jamal Musiala uu leeyahay dhibaato caafimaad oo la wada ogyahay, isla markaana kooxdu ay ka fiirsan karto wada-hadal ku saabsan dhimista mushaarkiisa haddii uusan si buuxda u bogsan.

item.title: Nigeria: Doon sidday dad u socday aas oo ku rogmatay gobolka Bayelsa, ugu yaraan 4 qof ayaa dhimatay
item.description: Doon la rumeysan yahay inay sidday boqolaal qof oo u socday xaflad aas ayaa Jimcihii ku rogmatay gobolka Bayelsa ee koonfurta Nigeria, waxaana ku dhintay ugu yaraan 4 qof, sida uu sheegay booliisku.

item.title: Shirka cimilada COP31 ee Antalya oo wakhti dheeraad ah galay, khilaaf ku saabsan shidaalka darteed
item.description: Shirka cimilada ee Qaramada Midoobay COP31 ee magaalada Antalya ee Turkiga ayaa Jimcihii dhaafay wakhtigii loo qorsheeyay, iyadoo ku dhawaad 200 dal ay isku afgaran waayeen qabyo-qoraal heshiis oo aan hadda magacaabin shidaalka.

item.title: Duncan Ferguson oo la kulmay guuldarradii iyo kaarkii cas ee ugu horreeyay ee Glentoran, Cliftonville 3-2
item.description: Cliftonville ayaa Jimcihii 3-2 kaga adkaatay Glentoran horyaalka Waqooyiga Ireland, iyadoo tababaraha Glentoran Duncan Ferguson uu la kulmay guuldarradiisii ugu horreysay iyo kaarkiisii cas ee ugu horreeyay tan iyo markii uu kooxda la wareegay.

item.title: Natiijo: Real Madrid Castilla 0-2 Real Murcia, Flakus oo laba gool dhaliyay
item.description: Real Murcia ayaa Jimcihii 2-0 kaga adkaatay Real Madrid Castilla garoonka Alfredo Di Stéfano, kulan ka tirsan Kooxda 2aad ee Primera Federación, iyadoo weeraryahan Flakus uu labada gool dhaliyay qeybtii hore.

item.title: NATO oo ku tilmaantay gantaallada Ruushka ee ku dhacay Poland xadgudub culus oo hawada ah
item.description: Xoghayaha Guud ee NATO Mark Rutte ayaa Jimcihii ku tilmaamay xadgudub culus oo ka dhan ah hawada Poland 2 gantaal oo Ruush ah iyo diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo la tuhunsan yahay oo ku dhacay koonfur-bari Poland.

item.title: Gerwyn Price oo ka badbaaday 2 fursadood oo ciyaarta lagu dhammayn lahaa, kuna gudbay semi-finalka Grand Slam of Darts
item.description: Gerwyn Price ayaa Jimcihii 16-15 kaga adkaaday Niko Springer ciyaar xiiso badan oo rubuc-finalka Grand Slam of Darts ah, kaddib markii uu ka badbaaday 2 fursadood oo Springer ciyaarta ku dhammayn lahaa.

item.title: Bayern: Harry Kane oo bilooyin ka maqnaan doona garoomada, Olise oo war wanaagsan laga helay
item.description: Bayern Munich ayaa xaqiijisay in Harry Kane uu dillaac kaga dhacay seedda canqowga bidix ciyaartii Köln, isla markaana uu bilooyin maqnaan doono, halka baaritaanka Michael Olise uu muujiyay in dhaawiciisu aanu ahayn mid culus sidii markii hore laga baqay.

item.title: Lassine Sinayoko oo loo doortay ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican bisha October ee Ligue 1
item.description: Weeraryahanka Paris FC, Lassine Sinayoko, ayaa ku guuleystay abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka bisha October ee horyaalka Ligue 1, oo ay bixiso ururka ciyaartoyda xirfadlayaasha ah ee Faransiiska (UNFP).

item.title: Espanyol oo San Mamés kaga adkaatay Athletic Club 1-0, gool uu dhaliyay Roberto Fernández
item.description: Espanyol ayaa Jimcihii 1-0 kaga guuleysatay Athletic Club garoonka San Mamés ee Bilbao, ciyaartii furitaanka wareegga 13aad ee La Liga, iyadoo goolka keliya uu dhaliyay weeraryahanka Roberto Fernández daqiiqadii 66aad.

item.title: Troyes oo 3-1 ku garaacday Le Havre, Antoine Mille oo 2 gool dhaliyay ciyaartii ugu horreysay ee Ismaël
item.description: Troyes ayaa Jimcihii garoonkeeda Stade de l'Aube 3-1 kaga adkaatay Le Havre ciyaartii furitaanka wareegga 11aad ee Ligue 1, iyadoo ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe Antoine Mille uu dhaliyay 2 gool.

item.title: Leganés oo Andorra kaga adkaatay 3-1, Álvaro Morata oo gool iyo caawin sameeyay ka hor dhaawac
item.description: Leganés ayaa Jimcihii 3-1 kaga guuleysatay FC Andorra magaalada Encamp, ciyaar ka tirsan horyaalka heerka 2aad ee Spain, iyadoo Álvaro Morata uu dhaliyay gool, kana caawiyay mid kale.

item.title: EuroLeague: Olympiacos oo 92-76 ku jebisay Real Madrid, Tyrique Jones oo 22 dhibcood keenay
item.description: Olympiacos ayaa Jimcihii 92-76 kaga adkaatay Real Madrid kulan ka tirsan wareegga 13aad ee EuroLeague-ga oo ka dhacay garoonka SUNEL Arena ee Piraeus, iyadoo Tyrique Jones uu kooxda guuleysatay ugu dhibcaha badnaa.

item.title: Bayern Munich oo dhib ku jirta: Harry Kane iyo Michael Olise oo dhaawac ku baxay ciyaarta Köln
item.description: Xiddigaha Bayern Munich Harry Kane iyo Michael Olise ayaa labaduba dhaawac ku baxay Jimcihii ciyaartii Bundesliga ee ay kooxdu garoonkeeda ku martigelisay 1. FC Köln, afar maalmood ka hor safarka Champions League ee Lille.

item.title: Tom Brady oo wada-hadal heer sare ah kula jira Chelsea si uu u iibsado saami yar oo kooxda ah
item.description: Halyeeyga kubadda cagta Mareykanka (NFL) Tom Brady ayaa la sheegay inuu ku jiro wada-hadallo heer sare ah oo uu ku doonayo inuu iibsado saami yar oo kooxda Chelsea ah, kaddib markii uu bishan iska iibiyay saamigiisii kooxda Birmingham City.

item.title: GOGOSHII WADA-HADALKA OO WALI LA HESHIIS LA’YAHAY: MAXAY TAHAY TALLAABADA XIGTA EE MADAXWEYNE XASAN SHEEKH?
item.description: Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dhinacyada mucaaradka ayaa galay marxalad cusub, kaddib markii ay soo baxeen warar muujinaya in Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed uusan weli isku raacin qaabka iyo shuruudaha lagu geli karo wada-hadalka uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku baaqay.

item.title: CONMEBOL oo si wadajir ah u taageertay Gianni Infantino doorashada guddoomiyaha FIFA
item.description: Ururka Kubadda Cagta Koonfurta Ameerika (CONMEBOL) ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqay in 10-ka dal ee ka tirsan ay si wadajir ah u taageerayaan dib-u-doorashada Gianni Infantino oo ah guddoomiyaha FIFA, doorashada 18 March 2027.

item.title: Liverpool: Van Dijk, Frimpong iyo Gravenberch oo diyaar u ah Man Utd, Van Dijk-na mustaqbalkiisa ma hubo
item.description: Tababaraha Liverpool Andoni Iraola ayaa sheegay in Virgil van Dijk, Jeremie Frimpong iyo Ryan Gravenberch ay u diyaar noqon karaan ciyaarta Axadda ee Manchester United, halka Van Dijk uu sheegay inaanu weli ogayn halka uu xilli ciyaareedka soo socda ku ciyaari doono.

item.title: Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu mamnuuco shirkadaha Mareykanka ee xarumaha xogta AI ka dhisa dibadda
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu mamnuuci doono in shirkadaha Mareykanka ay xarumaha xogta ee sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) ka dhisaan dalal shisheeye, isagoo ku hanjabay canshuur aad u weyn shirkadaha tiknoolajiyada ee sidaas sameeya.

item.title: Pascal Groß oo heshiis cusub oo ilaa 2028 ah u saxiixay Brighton
item.description: Kooxda Brighton & Hove Albion ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday in khadka dhexe ee reer Jarmal Pascal Groß, oo 35 jir ah, uu saxiixay heshiis cusub oo kooxda kula sii joogayo ilaa 2028.

item.title: NFL: Indianapolis Colts oo sii daayay quarterback-ka Daniel Jones, Anthony Richardson oo noqonaya bilaabaha
item.description: Kooxda Indianapolis Colts ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday inay sii daysay quarterback-ka Daniel Jones, maalin kaddib guuldarradii 26-3 ee ay ka soo gaartay Houston Texans, waxayna Anthony Richardson u magacawday bilaabaha cusub.

item.title: Chelsea oo ganaax £150,000 ah lagu riday heeso takoor diimeed ah oo taageerayaasheedu ku qaadeen ciyaar FA Cup
item.description: Ururka Kubadda Cagta England (FA) ayaa Jimcihii Chelsea ku riday ganaax dhan £150,000 kaddib heeso ka dhan ah Kaatooligga iyo Ayrishka oo taageerayaasheedu ku qaadeen guushii kooxda ee wareegga saddexaad ee FA Cup ee garoonka Charlton bishii January.

item.title: NFL: Puka Nacua oo qalliin jilibka loogu sameeyay, Rams-na bilooyin ayuu ka maqnaan doonaa
item.description: Tababaraha Los Angeles Rams Sean McVay ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in xiddigga kooxda Puka Nacua qalliin loogu sameeyay seedda MCL ee jilibka, uuna ka maqnaan doono garoonka muddo labo bilood ah.
